Read [Cells → Cross-sections](../public-pdk-examples/cross-sections.qmd) for the
complete OrcaPen registry, transverse geometry, and a component settings example.

For electrical assignments, read
[S-parameters & Ports](../simulation/requirements/driven-terminal.qmd#geometric-ports-simulation-locators-and-terminals).
It distinguishes layout connection ports, simulation locators, and solver
terminals. Generic component connection is covered by
[GDSFactory instances and ports](https://gdsfactory.github.io/gdsfactory/notebooks/01_references/).
